about_the_game:
This expansion adds a fully explorable new map to the world of Rising Star 2, allowing you and your band to take your tour to the southern continent!

Travel across various South American countries, play shows, win over fans from different cultures, and expand your music career in a region full of energy and passion for music. With new places to visit, routes to plan, and challenges to face, this expansion takes your road to stardom even further.

From Wikipedia:
The title is demonstrative of the force of the Brazilian fandoms, who make sacrifices to follow the rare and expensive international shows in Brazil. It's also been noted in the press that the phrase carries a literal meaning, without codes or ambiguities: it is, indeed, an invitation to come to Brazil.

From Wikipedia:
The title is demonstrative of the force of the Brazilian fandoms, who make sacrifices to follow the rare and expensive international shows in Brazil. It's also been noted in the press that the phrase carries a literal meaning, without codes or ambiguities: it is, indeed, an invitation to come to Brazil.
